description: Folders the tools that take a path may use: list_files, git_log, count_lines, search_text, disk_usage and doxy_check. Each key is the name the model uses as the first part of a path (core_dump/src means src inside core_dump); each value is the folder, absolute, starting with ~, or relative to the tools folder. Files and folders inside these folders are allowed; nothing outside them.
